Changes by migaku-camera: resampled to mono 22050 Hz, 16-bit PCM WAV,
trimmed quiet trailing audio, normalized peak to 0.7 and faded the last 10 ms.

The waveform is bundled as base64 in shutter-sound.js; playback requires no
external audio requests. No affiliation or endorsement by the artist is implied.
